question: Who is designated as the sacrificial animal within the Kula tradition?
premises: The referent is situated in the midst of the yoginī group.
This figure is identified as paśu.
This designation is stated within the Kula tradition.
inference: In the Kula tradition, the one placed in the midst of the yoginī group is called the paśu.
uncertainties: Whether paśu is literal or symbolic is not specified in this verse alone.
plain_english: In the Kula tradition, he who is situated in the midst of the group of yoginīs is called the animal.
